MEMORANDUM FOR RECORD

SUBIECT: LD 1075, An Act to Require Annual Reporting Regarding the Low-income Home Energy Assistance Program

Committee Chair Senator Curry, Committee Chair Representative Gere and distinguished members of the Joint Standing Committee on Housing and Economic Development,
1. Thank you for hearing me on my bill, An Act to Require Annual Reporting Regarding the LowIncome Home Energy Assistance Program. At this time I am no longer interested in pursuing this bill m any manner.
2. Since I first submitted this bill two things have happened. First, I have met with the Director of Maine Housing and have been both provided the information that I originally sought in this bill as well as shown that the information sought in this bill is publicly available by the organization's federal reporting requu-ements.
3. Additionally, the Government Oversight Committee, of which I am a member, has had a hearing with the representatives from Maine Housing and made additional concurrent requests. If the Government Oversight Committee feels in a future session that legislation is required, that committee has the ability to recommend more appropriate legislation.
